origins.section: A Nonzero Count Lower Than You Built Means a Coefficient Was Dropped
The Report's Violation Lines Are the Solver's Audit of Its Own Plan
Two Settings That Should Agree and Do Not Are a Numerical Symptom

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-nonzeros: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-nonzeros: 'small_matrix_value, default 10^-9... matrix entries at or below it are treated as zero.' And 'the only trace in the log is a count one lower than the model you built.'
recorded.prompt:q-report: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-report: "A useful rule for a nightly job is to flag any nonzero violation on a model with switched rows"; also "find the binaries that are not whole, and the coefficients they meet."
recorded.prompt:q-disagree: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-disagree: 'with a gap tolerance of 0 every run must report the same best value' and 'treat a changed objective or status as a strong sign of numerical trouble.'

recorded.prompt:q-nonzeros:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-nonzeros:a: 'The first line of the log describes the model as HiGHS received it, before presolve.'
recorded.prompt:q-nonzeros:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-nonzeros:c: 'Large coefficients are not dropped the same way: the 10^9 ... reached HiGHS, and its Matrix line printed it.'
recorded.prompt:q-nonzeros:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-nonzeros:d: With a = 1e-8 the log shows 'built 2 nonzeros; HiGHS: ... 2 nonzeros', so 1e-8 is kept.
recorded.prompt:q-report:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-report:a: The page says the run is feasible within tolerance, but a nonzero violation "says a binary was left between whole numbers". The rule is to "flag any nonzero violation on a model with switched rows", not to accept the plan unchecked.
recorded.prompt:q-report:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-report:b: "The violation line does not say that it matters; it says where to look." The rule is to flag the plan, not reject it, and both runs are called feasible.
recorded.prompt:q-report:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-report:d: "Rerunning with a tighter tolerance is not the fix: lesson 10.1.1 uses it only to diagnose."
recorded.prompt:q-disagree:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-disagree:b: 'Presolve on or off, HiGHS or SCIP: none of these changes which plans the model allows.'
recorded.prompt:q-disagree:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-disagree:c: 'every run must report the same best value.' Two different optima cannot both be right.
recorded.prompt:q-disagree:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-disagree:d: 'The trouble was in the models all along; the second run is what showed it.'
